items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And, Aga's blues is a good tune. [INTERVIEWEE] They got fairly popular. Oh, he had him singing them all right there.

ctx.x: Yellow Dog. That's good. That's in Handy's book.
And, Aga's blues is a good tune.

They got fairly popular. Oh, he had him singing them all right there. He was the mainstay for a while. That's the reason they called him Father of the Blues, all right, because he was the main one for a while. But they came out awful fast after that.
